abstract: Sensitive immunological techniques were used to detect retrovirus markers in human pregnancy. A total of 1,540 human cord-blood sera were tested for retrovirus-reactive IgG antibodies using solid-phase enzyme immunoassay and purified RD 114 virus as antigen. Of these, 118 (7.7%) sera were positive. Blocking assays with specific animal anti-p30 sera, use of control antigen, and electrophoretic protein experiments combined with immunological detection indicated that the human antibodies reacted specifically with the p30 protein. The occurrence of antibodies in cord-blood serum had a highly significant correlation to complications during pregnancy and also correlated to the number of previous abortions and stillbirths. When goat anti-RD 114 p30 serum was used in the peroxidase-anti-peroxidase tissue staining procedure, p30-related antigen was detected in sections of all placental specimens (early and term pregnancies, blighted ova, hydatidiform moles, destructive moles and choriocarcinomas). However, in each case only syncytiotrophoblastic cells were positive. These findings, supplemented with different types of blocking tests, lead us to conclude that retrovirus p30-related antigen is selectively expressed in the highly differentiated syncytiotrophoblasts, which in the normal placenta are directly exposed to maternal blood. It is suggested that retrovirus-reactive antibodies may represent an autoimmune-like immune response to the p30-related syncytiotrophoblast antigen escaping during cellular damage.
abstract_ja: ヒト妊娠におけるレトロウイルスマーカーを鋭敏な免疫学的手法で検出した。臍帯血清1,540例についてRD 114ウイルスを抗原とした固相酵素免疫測定法で、レトロウイルス反応性IgG抗体を検査した。そのうち118例(7.7%)が陽性であった。特異的動物抗p30血清による阻害試験、対照抗原の使用、免疫学的検出と組み合わせた電気泳動的タンパク質実験から、ヒト抗体がp30タンパク質に特異的に反応したことが示された。抗体の存在は妊娠中の合併症や、既往の流産・死産の回数と有意に相関した。ヤギ抗RD 114 p30血清を用いたPAP法による組織染色では、初期および正期妊娠、空卵、胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、絨毛癌を含む全胎盤標本でp30関連抗原が検出された。ただしいずれの症例でも陽性を示したのは合胞体栄養膜細胞のみであった。これらの知見と各種阻害試験から、p30関連抗原は母体血に直接曝露される高度に分化した合胞体栄養膜細胞に選択的に発現すると結論した。抗原が細胞障害時に放出され、それに対する自己免疫様の免疫応答としてレトロウイルス反応性抗体が生じるのではないかと示唆する。
